# Finnhub fixtures

(`/api/v1/calendar/earnings`, checked 2026-09-30) and company news (`/api/v1/company-news`,
checked 2026-10-02; links go to `example.invalid`). Commercial vendor data is never committed;
see docs/RUNBOOK.md for verifying the shape with a personal key.
